name: touch
description: Change file access and modification times

options.name: -A
options.description: Adjust the access and modification time stamps for the file by the specified value

options.name: -a
options.description: Change the access time of the file

options.name: -c
options.description: Do not create the file if it does not exist

options.name: -f
options.description: Attempt to force the update, even if the file permissions do not currently permit it

options.name: -h
options.description: If the file is a symbolic link, change the times of the link itself rather than the file that the link points to

options.name: -m
options.description: Change the modification time of the file

options.name: -r
options.description: Use the access and modifications times from the specified file instead of the current time of day

options.name: -t
options.description: Change the access and modification times to the specified time instead of the current time of day
